session_label: Ersal-Ceylan Alevi-Bektashi Culture Institute manuscript catalogue probe
purpose: Targeted check of a published Alevi-Bektashi manuscript catalogue surfaced during the literature-method review, to determine whether it adds any Cihansah Qaraqoyunlu / Hakiki witness lead beyond the current Alevi-community corpus.

source.citation: Ceylan, Omur and Mehmet Ersal. 2019. Alevi-Bektasi Kultur Enstitusu Arsivi Yazma Eserler Katalogu I. Alevilik-Bektasilik Arastirmalari Dergisi 20: 173-208. DOI: 10.24082/2019.abked.264.
source.source_type: published article and catalogue of 30 manuscript/cenk items from the Alevi-Bektashi Culture Institute archive

method.access: Downloaded the public PDF and extracted text with pypdf for desk-search triage.
method.text_extraction_recipe: Downloaded the PDF listed under source.pdf_checked; extracted page text with pypdf.PdfReader(...).pages; counted casefolded literal-string occurrences for each target term.
method.limits: PDF text extraction is a desk-search triage method. A zero-hit result does not prove the entire archive lacks a relevant witness, and it does not replace future inspection of later catalogue installments or the underlying archive.

results.summary: No Cihansah Qaraqoyunlu / Hakiki target term surfaced in the public PDF text of the 2019 catalogue installment. The article remains useful as Alevi-Bektashi archive context and as evidence that this community-adjacent manuscript-catalogue surface was checked.

disposition.article_value: contextual comparator for Alevi-Bektashi manuscript archive cataloguing and community-adjacent discovery surfaces
disposition.follow_up: No current release follow-up required. If later catalogue installments appear, repeat the same target-term and incipit probe.
